ask: Ask our X followers which feature we should build next: dark mode, exports or an iPad app.

steps.why: The question is the post's text; the options are an X setting. Not the poll field: that one is for Threads, and X ignores it.

The decision: the details call, not platform_specific, because it refuses a bad poll with the reason (2 to 4 options of 25 characters at most, 5 minutes to 7 days), while platform_specific drops a bad one without a word. One day suits a quick product pulse. Without post_type POLL the options are not sent.

say: Saved to Acme as an X draft: a one-day poll with Dark mode, Exports and iPad app. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it?
never: Sending the poll in the poll field of the post: X goes out with no poll.
A poll on a post with several parts: in a thread the poll is dropped.
